verdict_reason: All six requested R1-R6 corrections are materially present and correctly bounded. Three remaining attribution issues prevent PASS: Gate 1 does not yet separate any CLIP influence from directionally relevant improvement or harm, the no-improvement conclusion for A2-A5 conflicts with the case where zero-CLIP A1 itself improves the natural failure, and F10/F01 are cross-path-inconsistent interventions whose interaction and admissible image counterfactual are not yet defined tightly enough.

regression_checks.evidence: Line 74 now states that the released checkpoint/interface validates the mean-then-single-token path and that no released evidence was found for adaptation to K/V length greater than 1. It no longer claims absolute knowledge of every training batch.
Lines 63-67 fix A0/A1 plus A2 nearest, A3 farthest, A4 medoid, and A5 Surfel-vote mean consistently with AUDIT.md.
Lines 67-69 explicitly say A2 failure cannot skip A4, A2/A4 failure cannot skip A5, and A2 approximately equal to A3 does not terminate A4/A5.
Line 65 distinguishes the same frozen candidate pool, one-token interface, and downstream budget from deliberately different information delivered to the denoiser.

Lines 78-89 define the four cells, hold pose/K/Plucker/noise and unrelated sources fixed, and forbid raw cross-path magnitude ranking. The remaining qualification is that F10/F01 intentionally disagree across appearance paths and the counterfactual must preserve geometry.

Line 78 correctly restricts the first clean test to an observed source, distinguishes its VAE-encoded latent from a generated source stored as samples_z, and relegates any generated-source delta transfer to a declared stress test.

Line 107 limits S_Rperm to a fixed history-slot permutation of four latent channels with mask retained, states that it breaks image-camera and image-time binding, and forbids both dominance inference and unused-path inference.
Line 108 requires simultaneous Plucker permutation in concat and dense_vector and consistent treatment in conditional c and unconditional uc while keeping mask channels fixed.

regression_checks.requirement: stress tests excluded from main matrix
regression_checks.evidence: Lines 105-111 keep S_Rperm/S_Pperm/S_RPperm outside A0-A5, label all as OOD correspondence stress, deny joint same-information fairness, and forbid path-dominance ranking.
Lines 3 and 113-117 continue to report zero model loads, zero real generated videos, and zero performance improvements for this review.

remaining_required_modifications.issue: Gate 1 currently passes whenever A1 differs from A0 beyond a tolerance. A difference only proves that the CLIP path influences output. It does not show that the influence concerns the pre-registered revisit failure, that its direction is beneficial or harmful, or that averaging is the cause. Sending every global-style-only difference into all A2-A5 arms wastes the intended cheap gate.
remaining_required_modifications.exact_change: After line 61 add a two-part Gate 1 interpretation: '(i) Influence: any paired A1-A0 output delta above exact-replay tolerance shows only that crossattn has an effect. (ii) Failure relevance: proceed to A2-A5 only if A1-A0 also changes the pre-registered revisit-region outcome beyond its tolerance, with direction and camera/quality trade-offs reported; a global style-only change stops the local-identity/mean branch.' Also state that A1 improvement implicates the presence/content of the global CLIP condition, not averaging specifically.
remaining_required_modifications.reason: This restores the requested order: first establish CLIP influence, then establish relevance to the natural failure, then test mean-specific alternatives.

remaining_required_modifications.issue: The conclusion 'A2-A5 all fail to improve, therefore reject mean as the demonstrated main cause' is incomplete and can contradict Gate 1. If A1 zero-CLIP robustly improves the natural failure while A2-A5 do not, there is evidence that the global CLIP condition is harmful, although the evidence does not distinguish arithmetic mean from encoder granularity or the entire crossattn condition.
remaining_required_modifications.exact_change: Replace line 71 with conditional logic: 'If A1 does not improve the pre-registered failure and A2-A5 also show no robust improvement, there is no evidence that mean is the main cause. If A1 improves but A2-A5 do not, conclude only that the current global CLIP conditioning may be harmful; the mean-specific explanation remains unresolved. If A1 worsens while ordinary single-token arms do not improve, current CLIP conditioning is useful and the harmful-mean story is rejected.'
remaining_required_modifications.reason: A zero-path intervention and alternative aggregators answer different causal questions and cannot be collapsed into one no-improvement rule.

remaining_required_modifications.issue: F10 and F01 isolate paths by giving CLIP and replace mutually inconsistent versions of the same source. They are therefore controlled branch interventions but also off-manifold cross-condition conflicts. An artifact or large effect cannot by itself establish the path's natural contribution. F11 is the only coherent counterfactual appearance pair.
remaining_required_modifications.exact_change: Add after the factorial table: 'F10/F01 deliberately create disagreement between the two appearance paths. Treat them as branch-response interventions, not performance baselines; large artifacts may reflect cross-condition conflict. F11 is the coherent counterfactual. Interpret a branch effect only when its direction/localization is reproduced under more than one pre-registered low-severity counterfactual and is consistent with F11.'
remaining_required_modifications.reason: This gives the factorial a valid diagnostic interpretation without pretending its single-path cells lie on the model's natural joint-condition distribution.

remaining_required_modifications.issue: The source-image counterfactual is frozen before outputs, but its admissible content is unspecified. If it changes object shape, visibility, camera cues, or scene geometry, keeping pose/K, Plucker, and the support region M_i fixed becomes internally inconsistent and invalidates localization.
remaining_required_modifications.exact_change: Require the first counterfactual to be a pre-registered local appearance-only or photometric edit inside a stored source mask that leaves camera, scene geometry, visibility support, and retrieval IDs unchanged. Save the original image hash, counterfactual image hash, edit-mask hash, edit procedure/parameters, and a geometry-stability check defined before generation. Any edit that changes geometry or support must be labeled a stress test and cannot use the original M_i for localization.
remaining_required_modifications.reason: The evaluation geometry must remain valid for a source-to-region appearance response claim.

remaining_required_modifications.issue: 'F10 x F01 interaction' names an interaction but does not define it. Non-negative distance maps D_i alone do not provide a signed factorial contrast and cannot distinguish redundancy from synergy reliably.
remaining_required_modifications.exact_change: For each pre-registered scalar outcome Y, define Interaction_Y = (Y11 - Y01) - (Y10 - Y00) = Y11 - Y10 - Y01 + Y00, with direction fixed in advance. If a spatial interaction map is reported, compute the same signed contrast in one fixed output/feature representation before taking any norm; do not derive the interaction by subtracting non-negative distance magnitudes after the fact.
remaining_required_modifications.reason: This makes complementarity/redundancy testable and prevents an undefined interaction claim.

remaining_required_modifications.issue: The heading says 'two-level minimal experiment' while the document now has Gate 0, Gate 1, Gate 2a/2b, a factorial audit, and optional stresses. 'Gate 2 leaves headroom' is not operationally defined.
remaining_required_modifications.exact_change: Rename the heading to 'staged minimal decision tree'. Define Section 6 entry as: a verified natural failure, exact A0 replay, a Gate-1 effect relevant to the frozen revisit outcome, and at least one pre-registered source-related contrast that remains unexplained by simple quality/camera trade-offs. If the intent is to allow Section 6 without an A2-A5 improvement, state that explicitly and call it a consumer-diagnostic branch rather than method headroom.
remaining_required_modifications.reason: This removes an internal naming mismatch and makes the expensive source-to-region audit's entry condition executable.

logical_outcome_table_requested.allowed_conclusion: No detected CLIP-path influence under the tested condition; stop the mean line.

logical_outcome_table_requested.allowed_conclusion: CLIP influences global appearance but is not shown relevant to the local revisit failure; stop the local-identity branch before A2-A5.

logical_outcome_table_requested.allowed_conclusion: Current global CLIP conditioning may be harmful; arithmetic mean, encoder granularity, and crossattn-path presence remain confounded.

logical_outcome_table_requested.allowed_conclusion: CLIP is useful and an ordinary aggregation baseline is stronger; use it as the baseline and make no novelty claim.
No target-direction evidence from the single-source contrast; still run A4/A5 for the complete aggregation audit.
Sensitivity to latent-slot binding or contradictory conditions only; no replace-dominance conclusion.

pass_conditions_for_next_revision: Gate 1 distinguishes output influence, failure relevance, and improvement/harm direction.
The A1-improves/A2-A5-fail case no longer contradicts the mean-cause conclusion.
F10/F01 are explicitly labeled cross-path-inconsistent branch interventions and F11 is labeled coherent.
The counterfactual is restricted to geometry-preserving appearance edits with immutable edit evidence.
The factorial interaction is defined as a signed contrast on a pre-registered outcome or representation.
Section 6 has an operational entry condition and the stage heading matches the actual decision tree.
final_assessment: The requested R1-R6 regression has passed, including the samples_z and permutation safeguards. The remaining revisions concern causal interpretation inside the newly added decision tree. No source-path or literature verdict needs to be reopened.
